summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and the str-valued EndpointResolverBuiltins enum with all eleven members, values and per-member comments. (2) botocore/args.py: added the EPRBuiltins import; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint config (treated as no variant tags); added public compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults at the end of ClientArgsCreator, reusing the bridge's FIPS and DualStack lookups and the existing S3 and STS predicates. SDK::Endpoint key is always present, with None when absent. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added the EPRBuiltins import and TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derived from unittest.TestCase) covering each behavioral criterion. Verification: tests/unit/test_args.py, test_client.py and test_regions.py pass (415 tests) using the generator venv python. black, isort and flake8 are not installed in that venv, so formatting was checked by hand: no added line exceeds 79 columns (the one over-length line in args.py, line 315, pre-exists). Nothing committed.
